transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got three mandatory training sessions to get done in the next three workdays: forklift-operator certification, generator-operator refresher, and hazardous-materials handling refresher. Each one needs a two-hour block. Before I sign off on the schedule, I need updates from each of you. Training NCO, what's the status on the forklift certification course? Motor pool sergeant, where do we stand on the generator refresher? And safety officer, what do we need for the hazmat refresher? Let's hear what you've got so we can lock this in.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a critical constraint on the forklift certification. I confirmed the duty roster this morning: the only currently certified forklift evaluator is available for the company session exactly Wednesday from 0900 to 1100. That roster change hasn't been added to the company training slide yet, so it wasn't visible to anyone else until now. This means the forklift-operator certification block must be scheduled Wednesday 0900-1100, or we won't have a qualified evaluator to sign off on it.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a critical constraint on the generator-operator refresher. The motor pool training bay is occupied by a scheduled generator load-bank inspection from Tuesday 0800 through 1200. I received the maintenance booking from the shop supervisor, but it hasn't been entered on the training calendar yet. This means the generator-operator refresher must be held Tuesday from 1300 to 1500 — the bay won't be available any other time that works for the hands-on portion.
